title: PCS Edventures!, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: PCS Edventures!, Inc., a micro-cap education company based in Boise, Idaho, filed a Form 8-K disclosing shareholder approval of a 1-for-12 reverse stock split effective April 20, 2026. The reverse split was approved by 63,085,815 shares representing 54% of outstanding shares. The company is also addressing a historical FINRA notification failure related to a 2015 name change.
key_points: PCS Edventures!, Inc. is a micro-cap company (CUSIP: 693381109, CIK: 1122020) in the education sector.
Shareholders approved a 1-for-12 reverse split by a vote of 63,085,815 shares (54% of 116,823,148 outstanding shares).
The reverse split requires FINRA to set a record date and issue a new CUSIP number before becoming effective.
The company also disclosed that it failed to notify FINRA of a name change from 'PCS Edventures!, Inc. com' in August 2015.
Authorized shares will be reduced to 32,000,000 total (20,000,000 preferred, 12,000,000 common).
The filing references a Definitive 14C Information Statement filed March 23, 2026 for additional context.
